closure_claim: Every foreign-tax-paid amount reported in box 7 of a Form 1099-DIV furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form 1099-DIV box 7 only: it says nothing about boxes 1a, 1b, 2a, or 12, residual recorded non-composable boxes (3, 5), Form 1099-INT foreign tax, Schedule K-1/K-3 foreign tax, Schedule 3 completeness, or Form 1040 credit lines. Closed with members authorizes the multi-payer sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
title: Form 1099-DIV box 7 statement items, tax year 2025
